title: BadHost – CVE-2026-48710: Starlette Host-Header Auth Bypass
summary: CVE-2026-48710 is a critical authentication bypass vulnerability discovered in Starlette, a popular Python ASGI web framework, allowing attackers to circumvent host-based access controls through crafted Host headers.
problem_solved: Exposes and documents a dangerous Host Header injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to bypass authentication mechanisms in Starlette-based applications.
why_valuable: Provides critical security awareness for developers using Starlette, enabling them to patch vulnerable endpoints and implement proper host validation before authentication checks.
